name: spec-readiness-gate
description: Score a worker task spec before dispatch: a TypeSafe Jev battery checks the five contract fields and a pure-code policy returns dispatch, clarify (naming the weak fields), or escalate. Shadow mode first (MCP server + skill).

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API Key
typesafe_api_key.description: API key for the TypeSafe Jev model that scores task specs. Without it, every ask returns kind "config" and the spec-readiness skill falls back to its manual checklist.

mode.title: Gate mode
mode.description: shadow: score, report, and log specs but never block dispatch. enforce: follow the verdict (dispatch, clarify, escalate). Switch only after reviewing shadow data.
